name: GitHub PR Lifecycle
description: Operate an authorized GitHub pull request through local preparation, checks, independent review, and guarded merge decisions.
approval_boundaries: Require explicit authority for PR creation, review submission, auto-merge, merge, and issue mutation.
Never bypass branch protection or required checks.

phases.name: PR context
phases.instructions: Identify repository rules, branch state, requested PR action, and authorization.

phases.name: Source check
phases.instructions: Confirm the local change and acceptance criteria.

phases.name: Conditional local change
phases.instructions: Apply only authorized local changes, or record that none are needed.

phases.name: Authorized PR operation
phases.instructions: Perform only the currently authorized PR action.

phases.name: Issue traceability
phases.instructions: When authorized, link or update issues; otherwise record no-action.

phases.name: Required checks
phases.instructions: Inspect required checks, rulesets, and branch protection.

phases.name: Independent PR review
phases.instructions: Review metadata, issue linkage, reviewers, policies, comments, and checks.

phases.name: Merge readiness
phases.instructions: Before merge or auto-merge, confirm validation, rollback, and required gates.

phases.name: PR lifecycle handoff
phases.instructions: Report PR state, actions, checks, approvals, risks, and next action.
